summary: This bill requires Department of Homeland Security law enforcement officers and agents involved in border security or immigration enforcement to display identification and official insignia, and prohibits them from wearing face coverings, when detaining or arresting individuals.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses the conduct of law enforcement officers engaged in border security and immigration enforcement by requiring them to display identification and insignia. While it doesn't change immigration policy itself, it regulates the enforcement aspect, which is a central part of the 'Secure Borders' concept, by increasing transparency and accountability of agents involved in detentions and arrests related to immigration.
